subject: System Design
title: CORS: Cross-Origin Security
description: A micro-lesson that makes CORS: Cross-Origin Security usable.

hook.text: A malicious website tries to read your bank data by making an API call from your browser. CORS blocks it.

buildup.text: CORS controls which origins can make requests to your API. Browsers enforce it automatically.

discovery.text: The server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers. If the requesting origin isn't listed, the browser blocks it.

twist.text: CORS is a browser-only protection. Server-to-server requests bypass CORS entirely.

climax.text: CORS prevents unauthorized websites from accessing your APIs using your users' cookies and sessions.

punchline.text: CORS stops other websites from abusing your API through users' browsers.
